title: MediaRow missing Debug and Clone derives
description: media_db.rs:9 MediaRow has no derive attributes at all. Every other public row type in fieldwork-db (BookRow, TrackRow, AudioChannelRow, ArticleRow, CollectionRow, ReviewRow, PodcastSeriesRow, PodcastEpisodeRow) derives Debug + Clone. Missing Debug prevents logging/error context. Missing Clone prevents passing MediaRow through APIs that need ownership copies. This is an inconsistency that will bite downstream consumers.
close_reason: Fixed: Debug + Clone derives added to MediaRow
